Vacancy for Neurosurgeon
Friday, 08 October 2021
4211 Hits
Applications on plain paper along with complete bio-data, certified photocopies of academic and experience certificates are invited for the post of
Assistant Professor
in the Department of
Neurosurgery
which must reach the office of the Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram, Dist. Wardha (MS) latest by
14
th
October 2021
. Applications would be accepted on email ID (mail to:
secretaryoffice@mgims.ac.in
) or hard copy
.
The appointments would be adhoc or till the next Selection Committee meets.
Qualification:
MBBS with M Ch in Neurosurgery or equivalent with one year experience in Medical College post super specialization.
Experience   :
As per MCI & MUHS norms.
PAY SCALE  :
As per Rules of Kasturba Health Society
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
